item.title: Boys Basketball: Wakefield scores 16 as Alexander beats Holley
item.description: Austin Wakefield scored 16 points to lead Alexander to a 70-36 victory over Holley on Friday.Isaiah Wright added 11 points and 11 rebounds and Mason Snyder scored nine points for the Trojans.Wakefield had five rebounds and four assists.Alexander improved to 1-2.Photos by Melissa Brooks

item.title: Indoor Track and Field: Cramer breaks school record as Oakfield-Alabama/Elba competes at Brockport

item.title: Photos: Annual Toy Drive at Ken Barrett Chevrolet
item.description: WBTA, Ken Barrett Chevrolet and Cadillac, the Salvation Army, and City Fire, teamed up on Saturday -- as they do annually in December for what turned out to be perhaps the largest, most successful toy drive yet.Residents, businesses, and organizations in Genesee County donated hundreds of toys.Photos by Howard Owens.

item.title: Photos: Brothers McClurg at Northgate for Christmas festival
item.description: Nationally recognized Christian recording artists, with a studio in Batavia, performed a set of Christmas hymns some of their own songs on Saturday at Northgate Free Methodist Church as part of the church's A Very Northgate Christmas celebration.Rochester-based duo The Local Hang Ups opened for Brothers McClurg.Photos by Howard Owens.
